scope: Read only RUNSPEC and existing small result/history/timing/media/resources metadata; no model payloads, decoder, GPU, network or runtime edits
output: New caller-selected JSON under Q33; exclusive-create; only relative note paths/run names
resource_rule: gpu_board.free_bytes, not gpu; maxima include resource rows and last_sample even if guard prevented final row append; persistent rows filtered per request
missing: Preserve failure/missing/timing null, never turn missing into zero/PASS
metrics: Native history start/success delta and per-node observer wall; not pure GPU or end-to-end service benchmark
privacy: No raw argv/logs/addresses/absolute paths in output; bounded typed fields and input hashes
